HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 807/2023 Shishpal S/o Gangaram, Aged About 34 Years, R/o Ganesh Nagar, Ranisar, P.s. Bhojasar, Dist. Jodhpur.
 (Presently Lodged In Central Jail, Jodhpur).
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Rajiv Bishnoi.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mahipal Bishnoi, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 20/01/2023

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.160/2022, registered at Police Station Bhojasar, District Jodhpur for offences under Sections 447 & 376 of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner and prosecutrix were in regular touch with each other.
If anything happened, it was with the consent of the prosecutrix.
Learned counsel further submits that the incident took place on 18.04.2022, whereas the F.I.R. has been registered on 10.10.2022.
The petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time
, therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

Having considered the rival  circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail application filed by the petitioner deserves to be accepted.

Shishpal vs State Of Rajasthan on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180436573/
1
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Shishpal S/o Gangaram arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.160/2022,
registered at Police Station Bhojasar, District Jodhpur, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 109-Prashant/-
